en.headline: Fire Services rolls out new breathing apparatus with 10-second cylinder swap
en.dek: The department has equipped firefighters with faster connectors, an air-sharing system and clearer communications, and introduced reconfigurable training rooms at two stations.
body: The Fire Services Department said it has completed a full replacement of its breathing apparatus this year, introducing equipment that allows cylinder changes in under 10 seconds and lets two firefighters share air in an emergency.

Assistant Divisional Officer Ip Chi-ho said the previous screw-type connectors took about a minute and a half to change. The new quick-connect fittings lock with a light press. An emergency breathing safety system links two sets by hose so air can be shared if one firefighter’s supply runs low. Integrated mask microphones and headset radios filter background noise and free both hands.

Training facilities at Wong Tai Sin and Pok Fu Lam fire stations have also been fitted with movable partition systems hung from ceiling tracks. The layouts can be rearranged to simulate flats, industrial buildings, mini-storage units and subdivided units, helping crews practise in unfamiliar floor plans. The department plans to add three more similar training spaces.

zh.headline: 消防處全面更換新一代呼吸器 換氣樽最快10秒
zh.dek: 新裝備設快速接頭、緊急共享空氣系統及小隊通話器，黃大仙及薄扶林消防局訓練場亦引入活動式間隔。
body: 消防處表示，今年已全面更換新一代呼吸器，新設備可在10秒內完成氣樽更換，並設緊急呼吸安全系統，讓兩名隊員在危急時透過氣喉互連共享空氣。
助理消防區長葉志豪指出，以往扭螺絲式接頭更換氣樽約需一分半鐘，新快速接頭只需對準輕按即可鎖緊。新系統亦整合面罩式通話裝置及小隊通話器，具備麥克風與耳機，可過濾背景雜音，讓雙手保持自由。
黃大仙及薄扶林消防局的訓練場地已引入活動式間隔系統，利用天花軌道隨時重組模擬空間，可還原住宅、工廈、迷你倉及分間單位等不同火場環境。消防處計劃陸續增建三個同類設施，持續提升前線人員應變能力。
